json.upload_description_plain:
So I've been in isolated hotels all week this week and when not working, my escape was listening to a few new albums of the cinematic / ambient genre and enjoying a glass of red or 3.

It's a style I've always been drawn to and mixing the ambient scents with the glitchy high end bits and bytes has always been a pleasure to work on. 

I've yet again broken my decent headphones so this mix has been created through a cheap pair of creative HQ-140's so hopefully the sound is crisp and not rotten.

Enjoy.

json.upload_description_plain:
Wretched January seems to be passing. I was stuck a little, then struck by this simple sample of a balloon popping, which I heavily effected. It reminded me of the time I thought it might be a fun idea to watch that old French classic, 'The Red Balloon' with my son, when he was seven. It's actually a very upsetting movie,and needless to say, not really for children. I left the vocal distortion in at the end, because frankly, it's surprising and upsetting too. Apologies to Shagrugge for complete dis-assembly of his cool noise core tone sequence.

Lyric:


My hope is gone
little promises you made don't come

I want you back
You leave here deflated and alone

I loved you more
All your skin and blood was mine to adore

You disappeared
You left me here deflated and alone
